header.title: CopyToClipboard
header.description: Button that copies text to the clipboard and confirms it: it swaps the icon and label, shows a tooltip and announces it to screen readers. Use it next to commands, keys, links or code blocks. You can also use your own button or a function that receives the state.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props and copy to see the confirmation. All labels default to English, so the example passes the five text props explicitly.

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: With just `value`, an icon button copies the text. On copy, the icon turns into a check, the tooltip shows `copiedLabel` and the state resets after 2 seconds. Pass translated labels: `label`, `copiedLabel`, `copyAriaLabel`, `copiedAriaLabel` and `errorAriaLabel`.

label.title: With label
label.description: If `children` is text, the button shows it next to the icon and stops being icon-only. On copy, the text switches to `copiedLabel` and the button uses the `success` variant. The tooltip repeats the text; remove it with `tooltip={false}`.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: `size` uses the button sizes: `sm`, `md` (default), `lg` and `xl`. The icon grows from `lg`.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `variant` accepts the button variants. It defaults to `transparent`, meant to sit next to text or a code block.

tooltip.title: Tooltip
tooltip.description: `tooltipPlacement` picks the tooltip side: `top` (default), `right`, `bottom` or `left`. With `tooltip={false}` it isn't shown; the confirmation still comes through the icon and the announcement.

customTrigger.title: Custom trigger
customTrigger.description: If `children` is an element, it's used as the button: it gets the click, `disabled` and the tooltip. If it's a function, it receives `copied`, `copy`, `error` and `disabled`, and you decide how to show each state. In that case there's no tooltip.

input.title: Next to a field
input.description: A common case is copying a key or token shown in a read-only field. Use a `copyAriaLabel` that says what gets copied.

codeBlock.title: Code block
codeBlock.description: Placed in the corner of a code block, with `tooltipPlacement="left"` so the tooltip doesn't cover the top edge.

dynamicValue.title: Computed value
dynamicValue.description: `value` also accepts a function, called on each copy. Useful to build the text on the spot, like a link with the current filters.

callbacks.title: Callbacks
callbacks.description: `onCopied` receives the copied text and `onError` the error if it fails, for example if the browser denies permission or the `value` function throws. The second button simulates a failure.

timeout.title: Confirmation duration
timeout.description: `timeout` sets how many milliseconds the copied state lasts (2000 by default). With `0` or less it stays copied until the next copy.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: `disabled` blocks the button and the tooltip.

header.title: CopyToClipboard API
header.description: API reference for the CopyToClipboard React component: props, render props, CSS classes, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demo page.

import.title: Import
import.description: You can import it from the main entry or its subpath. `writeClipboardText` is the function the component uses to copy, in case you need to copy without a button: it tries the Clipboard API and falls back to an alternative method.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: It doesn't forward loose HTML attributes. For the default button use buttonProps, which accepts Button props except children, onClick, iconOnly, variant, size and disabled. className goes to the wrapper and classNames adds classes to root, button, icon and status.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.button: The default trigger is a <button>. When icon-only, its name is copyAriaLabel and switches to copiedAriaLabel on copy.
a11y.live: It includes a hidden region with role="status" and aria-live="polite" that announces copiedAriaLabel or errorAriaLabel. The button references it with aria-describedby.
a11y.labels: All five labels default to English ("Copy", "Copied", "Copy to clipboard", "Copied to clipboard", "Unable to copy"). Pass them translated.
a11y.trigger: With a custom element, the name comes from its text. The component adds aria-describedby, disabled and the click; if the element's onClick calls preventDefault(), nothing is copied.
a11y.render: With a function, the button and its name are up to you. The announcement region stays.
a11y.tooltip: The tooltip is a visual aid: the button name and the announcement don't depend on it.
a11y.disabled: With disabled the button is disabled and nothing can be copied.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.copied: Applied while the copied state lasts. Slightly scales up the icon.
rules.button: Default button or custom element. Receives `classNames.button`.
rules.buttonCopied: Icon-only button in the copied state. Paints the icon with `--gem-color-success-solid`.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: CopyToClipboard has no variables of its own: the button uses `Button`'s and colors come from gem-system tokens. To change the confirmation color, redefine `--gem-color-success-solid` in a class (see Style changes).

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: gem-system tokens used by CopyToClipboard, besides the button's.

items.--gem-color-error-solid: Wrapper color when the copy fails.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: Props of the component and of the function you can pass as `children`.

items.value: Text to copy. If it's a function, it's called on each copy.
items.children: Button text, a custom element or a function that receives the state.
items.timeout: Milliseconds the copied state lasts. With `0` or less it stays copied until the next copy.
items.variant: Default button variant. Switches to `success` when copying with a label.
items.iconOnly: Icon-only button. Defaults to `true` when `children` isn't text.
items.label: Button and tooltip text before copying.
items.copiedLabel: Button and tooltip text after copying.
items.copyAriaLabel: Accessible name of the icon-only button before copying.
items.copiedAriaLabel: Accessible name after copying and announced text.
items.errorAriaLabel: Text announced when the copy fails.
items.tooltip: Shows the tooltip on the default button or a custom element.
items.onCopied: Runs after copying, with the copied text.
items.onError: Runs when the copy fails, with the error.

items.error: Error from the last copy, or `null`.
items.copy: Copies `value`. Wire it to your button's `onClick`.
